headline: Trump says pardoning Jensen Huang remains an option
summary: Trump said pardoning Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his affair with an alleged Chinese spy remains an option, as Huang faces a House Foreign Affairs Committee meeting. The alleged spy previously worked for a company accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China. Outlets differ slightly on how directly they characterize her intelligence ties.
